candidate: Post-release camera-detection reappearance across 70 Mt Gibson red-tailed phascogale sites

publication.citation: Anderson et al. (2024), Remote camera monitoring and arboreal trapping methods used to evaluate the outcomes of a reintroduction of red-tailed phascogales (Phascogale calura) in Western Australia

response_header_firewall.acquisition: one independently verified HTTP Range request per byte, stopping on the first CR or LF

published_aggregate_evidence.source: Dryad metadata, README, and Anderson et al. article-level monitoring description
published_aggregate_evidence.note: Published materials establish 70 annual camera sites, surveys from 2018 through 2024, and detections in every annual survey, but do not publish split-specific observed undetected-to-detected or undetected-to-undetected counts for the frozen 2020-2024 endpoint. Model-based latent occupancy estimates are not substituted for observed transition counts.

pre_response_allowed: official tokenized six-file manifest with ephemeral URLs retained only in memory
the bounded physical header of Camera_survey_detection_data.csv through one-byte Range reads
pre_response_forbidden: any data row or value in Camera_survey_detection_data.csv
any row or value in Arboreal_trapping_capture_data.csv
the dynamically assembled whole-version ZIP body
any mirror or derivative containing row-level phascogale detections

source_identity.file_identity: exact filename + byte size + SHA-256 for all six version files

node_geometry.registry_rule: the 70 ordered Site values in Camera_survey_site_location_data.csv are unique and every site joins to exactly one deployment group in each 2018-2024 campaign
node_geometry.distance_semantics: Euclidean distance derived only from response-independent UTM coordinates

survey_effort.campaign_assignment: if Date deployed is in 2017 assign campaign 2018; otherwise assign the calendar year of Date retrieved
survey_effort.effort_rule: inclusive union of all valid deployment calendar days within site campaign
survey_effort.midpoint_rule: mean union-day index relative to October 1 before the named campaign

response_semantics.endpoint: observed annual camera-detection reappearance after managed releases ended
response_semantics.risk_set: closed-registry camera site with zero released detection dates in source campaign t
response_semantics.event: risk-set site has at least one released detection date in target campaign t+1
response_semantics.non_event: risk-set site has zero released detection dates in target campaign t+1
response_semantics.source_state: all closed-registry sites with at least one released detection date in source campaign t
response_semantics.detection_day_intensity: number of unique released detection dates per site campaign; used only as a lagged source weight
response_semantics.absence_basis: response-independent deployment table closes all 70 sites in all seven campaigns; no unsurveyed site campaign is zero-filled
response_semantics.date_mapping: each detection date must lie inside valid deployment interval(s) belonging to exactly one campaign for its exact Camera Site
response_semantics.missingness: blank, invalid, duplicate, unknown-site, or unmapped response identities cause terminal schema/identity STOP; no alias repair, interpolation, or carry-forward
response_semantics.boundary: observed camera-site detection reappearance, not latent occupancy, demographic immigration, parentage, or reconstructed colonization history
response_semantics.categorical_token_schema: Camera Site must exactly match the closed nonresponse registry; Detection date is strict day/month/year

temporal_split.fit_policy: fit exactly once on pooled eligible calibration risk rows; never refit on heldout outcomes
temporal_split.sequential_layer_a_policy: calibration outcomes update Layer A after each calibration prediction design; each heldout year is scored before that year's outcomes may update Layer A for the next year

count_gate.failure_action: write immutable non-estimable result with zero fits and zero heldout scores

process_source.system: 70 standardized annual camera sites inside the 7838-ha feral-predator-proof Mt Gibson exclosure
process_source.conditioning_boundary: the predictive claim is conditional on realized current detected sites inside the closed 70-site registry
process_source.managed_releases: 165 animals were released during 2017-2019; every analyzed transition begins in 2020 or later and therefore contains no managed addition
process_source.external_sources: not represented; the fenced post-release endpoint is not interpreted as physical immigration and no external source is added after response access
process_source.persistence: same-site possible-source persistence is admitted in the response-blind temporal closure audit
process_source.transition_relation: the full-support exponential world permits every distinct internal site pair; hard worlds remain falsifiable submodels
process_source.claim_limit: post-release internal source-conditioned predictive support, not ancestry or individual dispersal

world_scale.axis: response-independent UTM Euclidean site distance in meters
world_scale.kernel_scale_basis: the response-blind 50-percent LCC threshold; an analytical decay scale, not a fitted movement distance
world_scale.threshold_interpretation: minimal response-blind structural LCC regimes, not fitted dispersal limits

layer_a_rules.current_sources: all camera sites detected in source campaign t
layer_a_rules.source_weights: equal normalized weight across current internal sources
layer_a_rules.hard_world_support: exp(-distance/kernel_scale) for distinct pairs at or below the frozen LCC threshold, otherwise zero
layer_a_rules.full_world_support: exp(-distance/kernel_scale) for every distinct site pair
layer_a_rules.transition_normalization: Q[s,j]=W[s,j]/(1+sum_k W[s,k]); target support is the equal-current-source mean of Q[s,j]
layer_a_rules.update: after each observed transition, eliminate a surviving rule if any newly detected risk-set target has support at or below 1e-15
layer_a_rules.monotonicity: worlds may only remain or be eliminated; eliminated worlds never return
layer_a_rules.all_eliminated: stop and report frozen-universe falsification without scale or source rescue

comparators.baseline: frozen strong random forest with campaign, UTM geometry, survey effort, conventional source-distance exposure, and lagged detection-day predictors
comparators.augmented: the identical frozen learner and identical conventional predictors plus the unchanged ten-column Layer-B block

preprocessing_model_fit.missing_value_policy: numeric medians learned on calibration rows only and applied unchanged to heldout rows; an all-missing calibration feature stops before fit
